name: Epic's All in One Realism Patch Redux
teaser: An update to Epic's all in one realism patch
description_html:
an update to Epic’s all in one’s realism patch due to being outdated for Realism 1.4.7. there are too many changes to list, values for Handling, stability and muzzle flash/gas and some mild balancing changes. credit goes to EpicRangeTime and their realism patch developer that I used as a base ground to update the patch. due to the size of this mod pack notify me if there is any missing items that aren’t updated.

this will no longer be updated.

Since realism mod already includes the templates for these items, and others there is no need for me to update it.
